title: Operator mosaic for batch & cache help-flow
creator: Ethan Nguyen
description: Goal: Ship a compact, operator-focused UI pattern (the 'mosaic') that surfaces the minimum required controls and explainers for batch + cache policy tuning while preserving a clear path to signoff and rollback. This ticket covers high-fidelity mockups, an interactive prototype for developer/ops review, and an accessibility pass. The mosaic groups micro-panels: throughput beacon, cost ledger, prefix-safety ribbon, and a scenario combiner that lets operators preview the impact of small deltas without leaving the page.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Prototype shows 3-card mosaic with clear affordances for: set batch window, toggle prefix KV caching, and set safety thresholds. 2) Each card includes an inline 1-sentence rationale and one 'Why suggested' tooltip driven by heuristics. 3) Delta preview simulates expected p95 latency and monthly token spend for 3 scenarios. 4) 'Quick signoff' flow captures operator notes and produces a rollback-ready snapshot that can be attached to rollout records. 5) Design reviewed by Eng and PM and accessibility contrast >= 4.5:1 for primary controls.
design_notes:
- New visual motif: mosaic tiles with compact microcharts (sparkline + single KPI). Avoid full dashboard chrome inside the tile to preserve scanability.
- Interaction: click a tile to expand inline to a 2-column editor; keyboard-first interactions supported.
- Explanations: every suggested value has a single-line 'why' and a 'confidence ribbon' showing low/med/high to help operator trust defaults.
- Safety: embed an immutable 'guardrail strip' at the top that lists active hard-limits (e.g., max tokens/min throughput) with one-click 'safeguard override' that creates a high-visibility audit log entry.
- Copy: use plain-language microcopy; avoid modal-heavy flows.
- Accessibility: ensure focus ring and tooltips exposed to screen readers, allow keyboard toggles for presets.
review_comments: 2025-11-01 - PM (Maya Gonzalez): Love the compact tiles; ask to add a required field for 'customer-impact flag' when operator overrides guardrail.
2025-11-18 - Eng (Dmitri Petrov): Need clearer mapping from mosaic tile to runtime config keys (suggest column for 'affected runtime fields').
2026-01-12 - Accessibility review (Priya Shah): Tooltip content must be reachable via aria-describedby; contrast issues on low-contrast variant fixed in v2 mock.
2026-02-21 - Ops pilot (internal test): Operators appreciated inline delta previews; asked for ability to save a named preset from the tile; latency simulation needs explanation of assumptions.
2026-03-05 - Design review session: Agreed to add 'assumptions' link within delta preview and a one-click export of the rollback snapshot as JSON for Attach-to-Rollout workflow.
next_steps: 1) Finalize Figma with updated 'customer-impact' flag and 'assumptions' details (owner: Lina). 2) Create PRD snippet for ENG-2339 mapping table. 3) Hand-off dev tokens and accessibility checklist. 4) Schedule 1-week ops pilot with 3 customers.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Operators may over-trust auto-suggestions and apply aggressive batching causing latency spikes. Mitigation: conservative defaults (p95 guard), explicit confidence ribbon and mandatory 'impact flag' on overrides; simulate 'worst-case' scenario by default in previews.
